result.title: TraceKV: Policy-Preserving Low-Rank KV Cache Compression for Reasoning Vision-Language Models
result.summary: Reasoning vision-language models (VLMs) impose substantial KV cache demands from both large multimodal contexts and growing reasoning traces. Low-rank KV compression has emerged as a promising paradigm that stores low-dimensional latents of KV states and can be combined with quantization. However, existing low-rank methods often induce growing predictive policy drift from the dense model when compressing reasoning KV states, resulting in reasoning failures. We identify two key causes of this degradation: calibration-state mismatch between static contexts and on-policy reasoning states, and unequal error sensitivity across KV states. To address these challenges, we propose TraceKV, a training-free low-rank KV compression framework that unifies on-policy calibration, sensitivity-aware SVD, and global rank allocation under a single policy-preserving principle, substantially reducing policy-KL divergence during reasoning. Experiments across multiple VLMs and visual reasoning benchmarks demonstrate superior accuracy--memory trade-offs, achieving near-lossless reasoning accuracy with 5.64$\times$ KV cache compression when combined with quantization. Optimized low-rank attention kernels further deliver up to 1.83$\times$ end-to-end decoding speedup. Code will be available at https://github.com/AK-DREAM/TraceKV.

AI.brief_summary: 该文关注推理型 VLM 中 KV cache 占用过大问题，提出免训练的 TraceKV 低秩压缩框架，将 on-policy 校准、按敏感度加权的 SVD 与全局秩分配统一在「保持策略」原则下，并配合量化实现高压缩比与近无损的视觉推理精度。
AI.relevance_reason: 论文指出的静态校准与推理态失配、不同 KV 状态误差敏感度不均，以及用 policy-KL 度量推理轨迹保真度，可供核查哪些内部状态对 LVR 推理真正必要、缓存与注意力结构如何影响 latent 相似度与证据保留。
